display_name: 源域 DURA 上下文方差因子干预
description: 保留原粗恢复和物理作用，对上下文方差乘七个固定因子，以源 clean IQ 诊断有限因子族中的潜在空间。
authorization: 用户继续授权研发星地恢复网络；仅源域合法 IQ 诊断，不重启已停止任务。

code.environment: N607 GPU7, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7, FP32 TF32 off, batch 32

data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 672 frozen source pilot physical IDs, RX4/6 and RX8 by seven views; read indices/rx/scene/split only

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: Previously explored fixed source pilot; RX8 is source held group, not independent to DURA

permissions.claim_scope: Source clean-IQ privileged factor oracle, not deployable or identity accuracy

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Original DURA source provenance verified by frozen_dura
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original source-only DURA and same-contract source-only candidate, subject to completion check
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed DURA v1.0 and fixed 672 source pilot; no target selection

execution.gpu_policy: Physical GPU7, one this-run worker, at most three total compute workers; preserve others
execution.stop_rule: Stop on source role mismatch, source smoke failure, nonfinite output or any target/F/TX read; preserve stopped group and other owners.

expected_artifacts: result.json per-scene fixed factor and per-record oracle source IQ NMSE

metric_names: source IQ NMSE by context variance factor

rows.method: Frozen original DURA context variance multiplied by [0.125,0.25,0.5,1,2,4,8], recomputing both prior conditioning and MAP/CG
rows.purpose: Measure source-only potential of context variance calibration
rows.seed_notes: Existing pretrained source runs and fixed source pilots; no stochastic training, support or augmentation in this benchmark.
rows.budget_ref: 672 source records, batch32, seven fixed variance factors

notes: Variance simultaneously affects prior log-variance conditioning and physical MAP/CG; intervention is not solver-only.
Per-record oracle and group best factor use source clean IQ and scene metadata, not available for target inference; no candidate or target-selected factor is deployed.
Previously explored source pilot, not independent of original DURA; no TX, F, V, target or model updates.
Oracle is restricted to the tested seven-factor family and does not bound arbitrary recovery methods or identity performance.
